# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest minor release of `node-slm` receives security fixes.

| Version | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| `0.1.x` | No — pre-release |
| latest | Yes |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue. Email `security@frontal-labs.example` with:

- A description of the issue and its impact.
- Steps to reproduce.
- The affected version(s).

We will acknowledge within 48 hours and publish a fix within 14 days for high-severity issues.

## Scope

This covers the `node-slm` package and its source. Native dependencies (`node-llama-cpp`) are tracked separately — report issues there.
